conversation_starters.title: Monroe moves to voluntary water conservation after rain refills reservoirs
conversation_starters.summary: Monroe easing water restrictions after rains refilled reservoirs — a relief/mitigation angle, not a check-in harm, and locally interesting. You could open with: 'Did you see Monroe's back to just voluntary water conservation after the rains?'
conversation_starters.description: Monroe shifted from mandatory to voluntary water restrictions after rains boosted reservoirs; however, residents are urged to conserve water responsibly.

you_should_know.title: NC attorney general joins lawsuit over FEMA grant funding conditions
you_should_know.summary: NC AG joining a multistate suit over FEMA funding conditions — political-institutional story landing on the state; walk in aware, don't open with it. Continuation of the existing incident.
you_should_know.description: North Carolina Attorney General Jeff Jackson is joining a coalition of two dozen Democratic-led states in a lawsuit against the Federal Emergency Management Agency over plans that could withhold counterterrorism funding from states.
